secciones.titulo: The service begins by defining the issue
parrafos: At Valentín Motors, we understand that a Porsche workshop must consider the symptoms, the generation, and the car's usage before recommending maintenance, diagnostics, or repairs. That is why the initial conversation focuses not on a list of services, but on the car itself, its history, and the owner's expectations.

The assessment is based on the documented history, model version, mileage, previous work, vehicle data readings, testing, and the condition of components. When information is missing, the necessary checks to obtain it are indicated before converting a hypothesis into a cost estimate.

The scope is defined proportionally: the Barcelona and Madrid centers cover maintenance, engines, gearboxes, IMS, bore scoring, pre-purchase inspections, bodywork and paint, Storage, and vehicle preparation. Tasks are sequenced to avoid redundant disassembly, ensure symptoms are not masked, and prevent the replacement of an assembly when it can still be diagnosed or repaired.

Technical decisions are made based on the following criteria: urgent, preventive, and optional items are categorized separately. The estimate must explain the evidence supporting each recommendation and the consequences of deferring it. If a finding arises that alters the scope of the job, it is separated from the approved work and explained before proceeding.

Valentín Motors is one of the leading independent Porsche specialists in the country.

Established in 1979 as a specialist in service, sales, and restoration, the workshop has grown into a benchmark in the field, featuring facilities of over 1.300 m² in central Barcelona and a comprehensive service center of over 2.500 m² in Leganés (Madrid), all designed with the customer in mind.

In addition to workshop and maintenance services, we have departments specializing in projects and restorations, engine and transmission rebuilds, motorsport preparation, track days, and an extensive catalog of customizations featuring the German brand TECHART.

Our sales department has evolved over the last two decades and specializes primarily in the sale of the 911 range. Our sales team consists of industry experts who are passionate about everything related to Porsche.

secciones.titulo: “It is essential to have a trusted workshop like yours,one that helps you make the right decision and is staffed by skilled professionals using diagnostic equipment. It’s not worth taking unnecessary risks. You really should consider going to a specialized workshop every time.”
parrafos: Daniel A.
We follow the manufacturer-specified maintenance plans, using genuine spare parts and adhering to Porsche guidelines.

For 40 years, our specialty has been mechanics,specifically, engines. We restore, refurbish, and repair any engine from the brand. We offer a nationwide engine pickup service and return them once the work is complete.
We possess the machinery and tooling required for any type of restoration and machining work, as well as a dedicated department for sourcing parts when needed.

We restore all types of Porsche gearboxes, from early models like the 356, 915, and G50 to the latest 991 and 992 generations. We also service and repair automatic transmissions, eliminating the need to purchase new units.

parrafos: If you have found a Porsche you wish to purchase, we can perform a comprehensive pre-purchase inspection, assessing the vehicle's current condition and reviewing its history. This allows us to verify whether the seller's offer is fair and free of hidden issues. Inspections can be carried out at our Barcelona workshop or on-site, either domestically or abroad. The cost of the pre-purchase inspection is 250 € + IVA.
We offer technical services nationwide, as well as support for the workshop network through technical consulting.

parrafos: Bodywork repair and painting according to Porsche specifications: original colors matching the new paint code system. Cosmetic treatments to protect the bodywork from corrosion using modern methods. Vehicle preparation involving panel gap measurement, removal of trim and accessories, cataloging and chrome plating of parts, etc.

The service delivery aims to provide a clearly defined and documented intervention, with a dedicated technical contact and the option to internally route work related to the engine, transmission, or bodywork. The final explanation ensures a clear understanding of the work performed, the reasons behind it, and any future observations or scheduled maintenance required.

We also outline the limitations of the work. An inspection describes the observed condition; maintenance does not, in itself, fix a breakdown; and a restoration should not be considered complete until the car has been tested as a whole.

secciones.titulo: How to prepare for the initial consultation
parrafos: To make the most of the consultation, it is helpful to provide the model, version, year, chassis number (where relevant), and any available history. If there is a specific symptom, it is useful to describe when it occurs,such as whether the engine is cold or hot, or if the issue arises under load or during deceleration,and whether the behavior has changed recently.

Past invoices, photographs, and diagnostic reports help avoid redundant work, though they do not replace a current inspection. This information determines whether an inspection appointment suffices, whether the car needs to be transported to the shop, or if only the specific component needs to be sent in.

Depending on the car's condition and the desired outcome, the work can be coordinated with maintenance, pre-purchase inspections, engine work, and pricing. Each page outlines the specific scope of work prior to booking an appointment.

secciones.titulo: Do you work on both classic and modern Porsches?
parrafos: Yes. Our services cover everything from 356 and 911 air-cooled models to current generations, as well as Boxster, Cayman, Cayenne, Macan, and transaxle models.

secciones.titulo: How do I choose the right service?
parrafos: Describe the symptoms, usage, and vehicle history when booking your appointment. If a reliable diagnosis does not yet exist, the initial step is to obtain one before authorizing any repairs.
